detail: This purposive nine-case sample covers India, the US, the UK, Germany, Hong Kong and Australia. Africa, Latin America, the Middle East and most Asian and European publishers remain unsampled. No global concentration denominator or ranking is computed.

This packet concerns news publishers and their corporate parents. X/Twitter and other social platforms belong in a separate platform layer; shared owners do not erase operational or legal distinctions.

This ownership packet establishes no election-service, campaign-contract, political-donation or manipulation relationship. Advertising inventory, a campaign contract, private giving and corporate expenditure require separate evidence and relationship types.

The research cutoff is October 15, 2026. Each edge retains its own event or observation date; historical transactions do not automatically establish current holdings. The NDTV ownership snapshot is March 31, 2026. The News Corp proxy combines a September 2025 share count with an August 2026 denominator.

The FY 2026 annual report was found, but official NW18 and BSE PDF requests returned HTTP 403. No 2026 percentage was imported from aggregators. The opened Reliance-hosted FY 2025 note confirms the trust relationship, but the current aggregate promoter stake is not reconciled.

These sources establish transactions, positions and rights. Testing editorial intervention requires dated instructions, contractual rights, documented newsroom decisions and alternative explanations; a graph path alone is insufficient.

Funding ceilings, announced prices, statutory consideration, prior debt, per-share prices, rights-issue proceeds and net cash inflow must not be summed. The dataset supplies no currency conversion or cross-case monetary total.

Primary sources were checked by the researcher and programmatic validation is recorded separately. Independent review covers selected high-risk claims and does not establish exhaustive or continuously current global ownership.
